title: Write-Off History Protection — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Missed-Recovery Terms
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — write-off protection at a missed-recovery review.** The protection rests on the plan's latest write-off:

| Latest write-off's entry date | Highest tier the plan may keep |
|---|---|
| none on the plan | the tier one below its current tier |
| more than 365 calendar days before the payday | the tier one below its current tier |
| 181 to 365 days before the payday | the tier two below its current tier |
| on the payday or up to 180 days before it | Paystride Access Starter only |
| after the payday | Paystride Access Starter only |

Only the latest write-off on the plan is read. A tier named as one or two below the current tier never goes below Paystride Access Starter.

*Boundaries (hypothetical, days before the payday reviewed):* 366 days, one below; 365 days, two below; 181 days, two below; 180 days, Paystride Access Starter only; a write-off dated two days after the payday, Paystride Access Starter only.
